tasks.title: Complete Personal Information
tasks.description: Name, address, citizenship, parent info

tasks.title: Enter Academic History
tasks.description: Every course from 9th-12th grade with grades. This is the most time-consuming section.

tasks.title: Report Test Scores (Optional)
tasks.description: SAT/ACT scores are optional for UC. Self-report in app; official scores sent if admitted.

tasks.title: Activities & Awards (up to 20)
tasks.description: List up to 20 activities, honors, awards, volunteer work, employment. Quality over quantity.

tasks.title: Personal Insight Question #1
tasks.description: 350 words max. Pick from 8 prompts — choose the 4 that best showcase you.

tasks.title: Personal Insight Question #2
tasks.description: 350 words max. Second of 4 required responses.

tasks.title: Personal Insight Question #3
tasks.description: 350 words max. Third of 4 required responses.

tasks.title: Personal Insight Question #4
tasks.description: 350 words max. Fourth of 4 required responses.

tasks.title: Complete Scholarship Section
tasks.description: Review and apply for UC-specific scholarships within the application.

tasks.title: Pay Application Fee ($80)
tasks.description: $80 per UC campus. Fee waiver available if eligible.

tasks.title: Review & Submit Application
tasks.description: Proofread everything. You cannot make changes after submitting.

tasks.title: Submit FAFSA or CA Dream Act
tasks.description: Required for financial aid consideration. Use UCI's school code.

tasks.title: Submit Statement of Intent to Register
tasks.description: If admitted, commit to UCI by accepting the offer.

tasks.title: Create Common App Account
tasks.description: Set up your account at commonapp.org. Opens August 1.

tasks.title: Complete Common App Profile
tasks.description: Demographics, family, education, testing, activities, honors.

tasks.title: Write Common App Personal Essay
tasks.description: 650 words max. Choose 1 of 7 prompts. This essay goes to ALL your Common App schools.

tasks.title: CMU Supplemental: "Why CMU" Essay
tasks.description: Explain why Carnegie Mellon is a good fit. Be specific about programs, faculty, culture.

tasks.title: CMU Supplemental: School/College Essay
tasks.description: Why this specific school within CMU (Engineering, SCS, Dietrich, etc.)?

tasks.title: Teacher Recommendation #1
tasks.description: Ask a teacher who knows your work well. STEM teacher recommended for engineering/CS applicants.

tasks.title: Teacher Recommendation #2
tasks.description: Second teacher recommendation. Choose a different subject area.

tasks.title: Counselor Recommendation & Transcript
tasks.description: Meet with your counselor to request rec letter and official transcript.

tasks.title: Submit Test Scores (Optional)
tasks.description: CMU is test-optional. If submitting, send official SAT/ACT scores.

tasks.title: Pay Application Fee ($75)
tasks.description: $75 fee. Fee waiver available through Common App.

tasks.title: Review & Submit Application
tasks.description: Final review of Common App + CMU supplements. Submit before deadline.

tasks.title: Submit CSS Profile
tasks.description: Required for CMU financial aid. More detailed than FAFSA.

tasks.title: Submit FAFSA
tasks.description: Federal financial aid form. Use CMU's school code.

tasks.title: Mid-Year School Report
tasks.description: Your counselor sends updated grades. Follow up to make sure it's sent.

tasks.title: Create Common App Account
tasks.description: Sign up at commonapp.org and start your application.

tasks.title: Complete Common App Profile
tasks.description: Fill out personal info, family info, education, testing, activities, and writing sections.

tasks.title: Write Common App Personal Statement
tasks.description: Choose one of the 7 prompts; aim for 500-650 words. Multiple drafts recommended.

tasks.title: Complete School-Specific Supplements
tasks.description: Most selective schools require 1-3 additional essays. Check each school's supplemental section in Common App.

tasks.title: Teacher Recommendation #1
tasks.description: Ask a teacher (ideally junior-year core academic) at least 4 weeks before deadlines. Provide them with your activities list.

tasks.title: Teacher Recommendation #2
tasks.description: Ask a second teacher in a different subject area when school requires two teacher recs.

tasks.title: Counselor Recommendation & Transcript
tasks.description: Request through your school's college counseling office. Allow 4-6 weeks.

tasks.title: Submit Test Scores (if submitting)
tasks.description: Send official SAT or ACT scores via the testing agency. Most selective schools accept self-report initially with official scores at matriculation.

tasks.title: Pay Application Fee or Submit Waiver
tasks.description: Application fees range from $50-$90. Fee waivers available for eligible students.

tasks.title: Review & Submit Application
tasks.description: Triple-check spelling, dates, essay attribution, and that you've selected the right round (ED/EA/RD).

tasks.title: Submit CSS Profile (if required)
tasks.description: Required by ~200 selective schools for institutional aid. Different from FAFSA.

tasks.title: Submit FAFSA
tasks.description: Free Application for Federal Student Aid. Required for federal aid; many schools require it for institutional aid.

tasks.title: Mid-Year School Report
tasks.description: Your school sends an updated transcript with first-semester senior grades.

tasks.title: Final Transcript After Graduation
tasks.description: Once you've enrolled, your high school sends a final transcript to your chosen college.

tasks.title: Complete Personal Information
tasks.description: Account creation, basic info, residency.

tasks.title: Enter Academic History
tasks.description: All courses 9th-12th grade with grades. UC recalculates GPA.

tasks.title: Report Test Scores (Optional)
tasks.description: UC is currently test-free for admissions but you can self-report scores; they may be used for course placement.

tasks.title: Activities & Awards (up to 20)
tasks.description: Six categories: awards, EC activities, employment, educational prep, volunteer, courses outside high school. Be specific about hours and impact.

tasks.title: Personal Insight Question #1
tasks.description: Pick 4 of 8 PIQs; 350 words each. Prompt 1 is the same across all UCs.

tasks.title: Personal Insight Question #2
tasks.description: Different prompt; 350 words. Choose to highlight different aspects of yourself.

tasks.title: Personal Insight Question #3
tasks.description: Third PIQ; 350 words.

tasks.title: Personal Insight Question #4
tasks.description: Final PIQ; 350 words.

tasks.title: Complete Scholarship Section
tasks.description: UC system-wide scholarship application embedded in the main app.

tasks.title: Pay Application Fee ($80 per campus)
tasks.description: $80 per UC campus you apply to. Fee waivers available.

tasks.title: Review & Submit Application
tasks.description: Final review of all sections. UC application is one app sent to multiple campuses.

tasks.title: Submit FAFSA or CA Dream Act
tasks.description: Required for institutional aid at any UC.

tasks.title: Submit Statement of Intent to Register
tasks.description: After admission decisions; choose your campus.

tasks.title: Create Cal State Apply Account
tasks.description: Sign up at calstate.edu/apply.

tasks.title: Complete Personal Information
tasks.description: Basic info, residency, contact.

tasks.title: Enter Academic History
tasks.description: Courses, grades. CSU uses A-G coursework; verify completion.

tasks.title: Report Test Scores (Optional)
tasks.description: CSU is currently test-free for general admissions; some impacted majors may consider scores.

tasks.title: Complete Major-Specific Supplements
tasks.description: Some impacted majors require additional info or essays. Check your campus + major page.

tasks.title: Pay Application Fee ($70 per campus)
tasks.description: $70 per CSU campus. Fee waivers available for eligible students.

tasks.title: Review & Submit Application
tasks.description: Final check before submission. CSU application is one app to multiple campuses.

tasks.title: Submit FAFSA or CA Dream Act
tasks.description: Required for state and federal aid at any CSU.

tasks.title: Submit Statement of Intent to Register
tasks.description: After admission; commit to your campus by May 1.

tasks.title: Create MIT Application Account
tasks.description: MIT uses its own application portal, not Common App.

tasks.title: Complete Biographical & Family Info
tasks.description: Personal info, family background, parental education.

tasks.title: Enter Academic History & Self-Reported Coursework
tasks.description: Courses 9-12, grades, school context.

tasks.title: Activities & Work Experience (4 entries)
tasks.description: MIT limits activities; quality and depth matter most.

tasks.title: Write 5 Short-Answer Essays
tasks.description: Each 100-225 words. Prompts about background, community, problem-solving, fun activities, and challenges.

tasks.title: Counselor Statement
tasks.description: Request through your school's counseling office.

tasks.title: Math/Science Teacher Recommendation
tasks.description: Required: one teacher of math or science.

tasks.title: Humanities/Social Sciences Teacher Recommendation
tasks.description: Required: one teacher of humanities, social sciences, or language.

tasks.title: Submit SAT or ACT Scores (Required)
tasks.description: MIT requires either SAT or ACT for the 2026-27 cycle.

tasks.title: Educational Counselor Interview (Optional)
tasks.description: Optional alumni interview if available in your area; encouraged.

tasks.title: Pay $85 Application Fee or Waiver
tasks.description: Fee waivers available; ask via the application.

tasks.title: Submit Application
tasks.description: EA: Nov 1. RD: Jan 1.

tasks.title: Submit CSS Profile
tasks.description: Required for institutional aid at MIT.

tasks.title: Submit FAFSA
tasks.description: Required for federal aid.

tasks.title: Start Caltech Application
tasks.description: Caltech uses its own portal (or Common App, depending on year).

tasks.title: Academic Record & Self-Reported Coursework
tasks.description: Strong emphasis on math/science rigor; report all STEM coursework in detail.

tasks.title: Caltech Supplemental Essays
tasks.description: Multiple short essays focused on STEM curiosity and creative problem-solving.

tasks.title: Counselor Recommendation
tasks.description: Counselor letter + secondary school report.

tasks.title: Math or Science Teacher Recommendation
tasks.description: Caltech requires a STEM teacher recommendation.

tasks.title: Humanities Teacher Recommendation
tasks.description: Required: humanities or social sciences teacher.

tasks.title: Submit SAT or ACT Scores
tasks.description: Caltech reinstated standardized testing requirements; check current policy.

tasks.title: Pay $75 Application Fee or Waiver
tasks.description: Fee waiver available.

tasks.title: Submit Application
tasks.description: EA: Nov 1. RD: Jan 3.

tasks.title: Submit CSS Profile
tasks.description: Required for institutional aid.

tasks.title: Submit FAFSA
tasks.description: Required for federal aid.

tasks.title: Create Georgetown Application Account
tasks.description: Georgetown uses its own application, not Common App.

tasks.title: Complete Biographical Information
tasks.description: Personal, family, residency.

tasks.title: Academic Record & Coursework
tasks.description: Self-reported transcript with grades and rigor info.

tasks.title: Write Required Essays (3 short + 1 long)
tasks.description: Why Georgetown, why your school within Georgetown, plus shorter prompts.

tasks.title: Counselor Recommendation
tasks.description: Plus secondary school report.

tasks.title: Teacher Recommendation
tasks.description: One teacher recommendation required (more accepted).

tasks.title: Submit Test Scores (Optional)
tasks.description: Georgetown is test-optional but recommends submitting if scores are competitive.

tasks.title: Alumni Interview (Optional)
tasks.description: Optional alumni interview; available in many regions.

tasks.title: Pay $75 Application Fee or Waiver
tasks.description: Fee waiver available.

tasks.title: Submit Application
tasks.description: REA: Nov 1. RD: Jan 10.

tasks.title: Submit CSS Profile
tasks.description: Required for institutional aid.

tasks.title: Submit FAFSA
tasks.description: Required for federal aid.
